seen_animation: A paintbrush drawn in black, bristles pointing up-left, the bristle head a pointed oval filled with a zigzag scribble, the handle two straight lines spreading apart down to the bottom edge. A thin grey line runs up-right from just above the bristle tip. Frames 1-4: the brush stays near the upper-middle with a short grey line. Frames 5-15: the brush slides gradually down and to the left while the grey line lengthens toward the lower left, so the brush appears to be laying down the stroke. Frame 16: the brush is suddenly back up and to the right (about where it was in frames 4-8) and the grey line now extends past it to the left. Grey scenery (a hook-shaped curl top-left, a diagonal curve bottom-left, vertical lines on the right) does not change.
seen_film: Close-up of a real paintbrush with dark bristles and a clear/white ferrule, tip up-left, on tan paper. A thin dark line runs up-right from the bristle tip. Frames 1-4: brush near upper-middle, small drift. Frames 5-15: the brush moves down and left in steps while the painted line lengthens behind it toward the lower left; frames 11, 12 and 15 show the brush motion-blurred into a double image. Frame 16: the brush is back up and to the right, partly blurred, as if lifted and returned for the next stroke.
named_subject: a paintbrush (bristle head with scribbled hair and a handle) painting a thin line
evidence: Brush positions per cell track the film within about 20 px in every frame: 1 (~150,125 vs film ~145,125), 6 (~135,140 vs ~115,143), 9 (~115,161 vs ~130,141), 13 (~95,174 vs ~100,164), 14 (~90,175 vs ~95,169), and the return in 16 (~140,150 vs ~175,124), which the film also has. The grey stroke lengthens from frame 1 to 15 at the same rate as the film's painted line (left end near x 125 in 9, near x 97 in 15). The animation does not reproduce the film's blur doubling in 11, 12, 15, giving a single clean drawing each frame. The bristle head's zigzag scribble inside a pointed outline matches c.png's bristle construction. Judged from still frames only, not playback.
primary_gap: In frames 1-8 the grey painted line starts about 10-15 px up-right of the bristle tip instead of touching it, so the brush does not visibly lay down the line it is moving along, whereas the film's line meets the tip.
closes_when: In every frame 1-15 the lower-left end of the grey line sits exactly on the bristle tip point.
protect: The frame-by-frame placement and down-left path that matches the film, the frame-16 return matching the film's, the steadily growing stroke, the zigzag-scribble bristle head from c.png kept as one consistent drawing without doubling, and the unchanged grey scenery.
identity_gap: The bristle head matches c.png, but the handle is drawn as two open diverging lines rather than the doodle's single closed, narrow, slightly tapered handle outline.
